title: Under a Mumbai forest, a tunnel machine digs 5 metres a day through ancient lava rock
description: Hard Deccan basalt has slowed Mumbai’s first boring machine to 5.5 metres a day, and under 3 on bad days, as it cuts a 6.65-km twin tunnel beneath Sanjay Gandhi National Park. The Rs 6,600-crore tunnel is meant to cut a 90-minute east-west crossing of the city to 20 minutes by 2028.
